purpose: Teach: 対人/竹下/地主/産ん/取り出す/昌/キツイ/岬

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、対人関係に悩んでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer — she's been having a hard time with people lately, she told me.
lines.style: Soft concerned murmur, slowing with sympathy, a gentle fall at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、竹下景子さんのファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Mei, apparently that customer is a big fan of Keiko Takeshita.
lines.style: Bright little discovery shared over the counter, warm and unhurried.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、地主のご祖父様のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And she told me all about her grandfather — he was a landowner, apparently.
lines.style: Hushed storyteller tone, savoring the detail, gentle wonder rising through the line.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子様を産んで一年だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Mei, that customer said it's been a whole year since she had her baby.
lines.style: Tender softening on the baby news, a warm hum carrying under the words.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ガラス容器の中からビスケットを取り出す仕草が上品だったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And the way she took the biscuits out of the glass jar — so elegant, Aoi.
lines.style: Admiring hush, slowing as if miming the gesture, a delighted little sigh after.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お孫様のお名前が昌くんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Mei, apparently her grandson's name is Sho — little Sho-kun.
lines.style: Fond smiling delivery, a tiny affectionate lift landing on the name.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「最近の運営はキツイ」って苦笑いされてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And she gave this wry smile and said keeping the place running is tough these days.
lines.style: Gently echoing the customer's rueful tone, a soft sympathetic laugh at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、岬の灯台のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And she told me the loveliest story about the lighthouse out on the cape, Mei.
lines.style: Dreamy closing warmth, pace easing down, voice drifting toward the picture.
